Title: DATA SCIENTIST
Description: Magotteaux is a world leader in the sale of products for the cement, mining and aggregates industries. Prepare and clean data, engineer features, and build and test statistical and machine learning models in Databricks. Design experiments and evaluate models for statistical validity, business relevance, and appropriate performance measures. Deploy, monitor, document, and retrain models using sound MLOps practices; identify and address model drift. Communicate findings through clear narratives, presentations, visualizations, and Power BI reports when appropriate. Exposure to plant systems such as SCADA, MES or process historians (for example Ignition/Sepasoft, already referenced in the DSD job family) Applied statistics and hypothesis testing; supervised and unsupervised machine learning; feature engineering; model evaluation; data preparation and quality; SQL-based data retrieval; experimental design; data storytelling; responsible and secure use of data and AI. Strong hands-on Python and SQL. Practical experience with Databricks and common machine learning libraries. Ability to prepare data, engineer features, build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models. Ability to design experiments and select appropriate model performance measures. Ability to deploy, monitor, document, and retrain models using sound MLOps practices. Ability to create clear visualizations and reports; Power BI and Excel experience is useful. Familiarity with Azure, Git/Azure DevOps, model deployment, monitoring, and MLOps is preferred. Special requirements Hybrid Work (primarily on-site) Ability to collaborate with global teams and travel internationally when required. Comfortable working in a plant environment alongside operators, maintenance and process engineers Valid Passport and ability to obtain required visas, included United States of America Fluent professional English, written and spoken, is required. What do we offer Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment.

Title: Coordinador de Analítica Comercial
Description: Oportunidad Laboral Grupo DEACERO tiene un firme compromiso con un crecimiento sustentable que beneficie a sus clientes, medio ambiente, empleados y comunidades donde está presente. Somos una empresa dedicada a la recolección y procesamiento de chatarra, fundición de acero, plantas fabricantes de productos de alambre y centros de distribución. Atendemos a diversas industrias y mercados del acero en México y en más de 20 países de América y Europa, tales como Estados Unidos, Canadá, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Colombia, Chile, Perú, España y Reino Unido. Visualizamos a la sustentabilidad como el eje rector en sus operaciones generando valor en lo ambiental, económico y social y dueña de desarrollos sustentables en tecnología avanzada para el reciclaje de acero y su conversión en productos terminados, siempre cumpliendo las normas de calidad ASTM y otras a nivel internacional. Estamos conformados por más de 9,000 empleados y contamos con 21 Centros de Reciclaje, 3 Acerías, 15 Plantas de Producto Terminado y 1 Centro de Investigación y 26 centros de distribución. Actividades y/o funciones: Habilitar las decisiones de precio de la BU Aceros mediante la integración, el análisis y el modelado de datos de múltiples fuentes: construye y opera los productos de datos, modelos, alertas y tableros que sustentan la estrategia de precios y el check & balance de precios, bajo la metodología y los estándares que define la Jefatura de Precios & Rentabilidad. Idioma: Inglés, B2 ¡Muchas gracias por pensar en Grupo DEACERO para empezar o continuar con tu carrera profesional! Integrar y depurar las fuentes de datos de precios (transaccionales, costos, chatarra, referencias de mercado y macro) en productos de datos de precio sobre BigQuery con modelo en estrella, bajo los estándares de fuentes oficiales que define Inteligencia Comercial, para que los análisis de precio sean reproducibles y reutilizables. Desarrollar y mantener los modelos analíticos de precio (elasticidad, pisos, optimización y simulación de escenarios) con Python/SQL, bajo los estándares de modelado, validación y medición del valor que define la Jefatura (Journey de Precios, arquitectura y cascada de precio), para sustentar cada decisión de precio con evidencia cuantitativa. Construir y mantener las reglas automatizadas de detección de desviaciones de precio (transacciones fuera de banda, bajo piso o con fugas) sobre los datos transaccionales, que Inteligencia Comercial usa en el check & balance, para detectar fugas de precio a tiempo. Calcular, bajo el diseño de la Jefatura, la medición del valor de precios (cascada de precio, escalones del P&L, valor esperado vs. capturado) y mantener los tableros de precio dentro del portafolio oficial que gobierna Inteligencia Comercial, para que Comercial y la Dirección monitoreen desempeño y resultados. Monitorear los indicadores externos relevantes para precio (costo de chatarra, precios internacionales, referencias CRU/Platts/SteelOrbis, macro) y asegurar la calidad de los datos de precios internacionales, incorporándolos a modelos y análisis, para anticipar movimientos de mercado en la decisión de precio. Title: Consumer Risk Specialist
Description: Job Description Why GM Financial? GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses. At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive. Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. This position will be posted until filled. Responsibilities About the Role The Risk Consumer Specialist is a senior individual contributor responsible for providing advanced credit risk analytics and leading risk initiatives that support profitable and sustainable business growth while maintaining appropriate risk disciplines and appetite. The role will have a strong focus on consumer credit risk, covering credit policies, originations, credit decisioning, portfolio performance, risk segmentation, and emerging risk identification. This position is expected to translate complex data and portfolio trends into actionable risk strategies, provide recommendations to senior stakeholders, and act as a key point of connection between Consumer Risk, Credit Operations, Analytics, Technology, and central/global Risk teams. The role requires a high degree of autonomy, analytical judgment, business understanding, and ownership of initiatives, operating as a subject matter expert across different components of the consumer credit risk lifecycle.The position provides leadership and oversight across Credit Origination, Portfolio Risk Management, Leasing & Residual Values, Credit Loss Reserves, and Credit Decisioning Platforms, ensuring effective governance, risk measurement, controls, and decision-making throughout the credit lifecycle. In This Role You Will Manage and oversee credit decisioning platforms from a Risk perspective, ensuring credit policies, strategies and decision rules are appropriately implemented and aligned with business and risk requirements. Serve as the primary Consumer Risk point of contact for Credit Operations on matters related to decisioning platforms, credit policies, system functionality and credit strategy implementation. Coordinate with central and global teams on the implementation, enhancement and evolution of credit decisioning tools and capabilities, representing Mexico Consumer Risk requirements and priorities. Partner with Credit Operations, Technology, Analytics and central teams to translate risk strategies and business requirements into decisioning capabilities and system requirements. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and simplify credit decisioning processes, including increased automation, reduced manual intervention and improvements in the effectiveness of the credit evaluation process. Define and develop the analytics and monitoring framework for credit decisioning platforms, establishing relevant indicators to assess strategy performance, decision outcomes, overrides, declines, referrals and other key decisioning trends. Develop, assess, validate and monitor consumer credit policies and underwriting strategies, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, business objectives and market conditions. Perform advanced analysis of consumer portfolio performance, identifying emerging risks, changes in customer behavior and opportunities to strengthen portfolio quality. Monitor relevant risk indicators across the credit lifecycle, including delinquency, losses, vintages, roll rates and other portfolio performance measures. Perform ad hoc risk analyses, data assessments and strategic evaluations as business needs arise, translating complex information into actionable insights, recommendations and risk proposals to support management decision-making. Qualifications What makes You an ideal candidate? Knowledge of portfolio performance indicators, including delinquency, roll rates, vintage analysis, losses, recoveries, expected losses, and risk-adjusted profitability. Understanding of credit decisioning platforms, rules-based strategies, model implementation, testing, monitoring, and controlled change management. Ability to communicate credibly and effectively with regulators, auditors, executive management, and governance committees. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect detailed data findings to commercial, financial, and strategic decisions. Business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand the impact of risk decisions on growth, profitability, reserves, and customer experience. Proficiency in data analysis and management reporting tools. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills in Spanish and English. Work Experience & Education Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related quantitative field. Relevant professional experience in Credit Risk, Consumer Finance, Financial Services, Risk Analytics or Credit Strategy. What We Offer At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities, where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community, while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits. Some of our global benefits include Extended Maternity & Paternity Leaves, Personal Days & Community Investment hours. GM Financial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, age, gender, marital status, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or any other that undermines human dignity and aims to nullify or impair people’s rights and freedoms. The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments. Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework. Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI. Solid experiment design and uplift measurement. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Title: Delivery Engineer, Data, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM. The hard problem The challenge isn't moving rows; it's reasoning consistency. Our AI must produce the same high-quality insights wherever the data lives, from data that is different at every customer. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions. What You'll Do Data discovery: work with the customer's engineers to understand their sources, and help build our Data Discovery Agent, which will analyze data, suggest mappings and scaffold first pipelines. Canonical modeling: map source data into Hilbert's unified growth models, and help shape new models for industries we haven't served yet. Hybrid integration: build and run ETL and ELT pipelines through Hilbert's data orchestration layer, which controls them whether they run on our stack (Dagster, Airbyte, ClickHouse) or natively in the customer's warehouse. AI semantic layer: define the metadata, metrics and business logic in our semantic layer, built on Cube (cube.dev), that let our agents understand custom data without hallucinating. Secure integration: connect Hilbert and the customer's cloud with least-privilege access and private connectivity. Data quality: own monitoring and quality checks until the deployment is production-ready, and keep it healthy. Productization: turn repeated work into product with our product engineering team. Who You Are The translator: you earn the trust of a customer's data architect quickly and turn the logic of their custom tables into something our reasoning engine understands. The data ontologist: you know AI needs more than a table; it needs context, and you have the discipline to define what the data means. The pilot: you're excited to help build AI agents that take on the heavy lifting of discovery and pipeline scaffolding. The systems thinker: you build reusable patterns, tests and automation instead of one-off pipelines, so a small team can deliver across very different environments without cutting corners. The adapter: you're at home in whatever environment a customer brings, from their cloud and warehouse to their security rules, and you find a working solution quickly. Extensive data engineering experience, with expert SQL and data modeling, strong Python, and dbt or Spark. Hands-on with Databricks, Snowflake (including Snowpark) or BigQuery, and ClickHouse, plus an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow. Working knowledge of cloud IAM and networking on AWS, Azure or GCP. Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America. Nice to have ML engineering experience DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Able to travel to the US when necessary Why join us At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Title: CRO Lead (Hands-On)
Description: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work - building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday - keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round Speed Is King - move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day Work Smart - AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts Overdeliver - catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what Success Looks Like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands - measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert - CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website - tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise - AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed - drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells Brief, QA and launch tests every week - then call results honestly and ship the winners Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3-4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV - with the data to back it up Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work Excellent cultural fit as per our values above Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience Accountabilities What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week. CRO test plan and backlog - Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next Funnels - Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV Build, QA and launch tests - Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week Results, winners and conversion monitoring - Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day CRO agency - Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house CRO reporting and meetings - Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate Application + Screening Test Project Technical Interview Culture Fit Interview Salary Expectation USD $4,000 - $6,000+ per month (based on experience and expertise).

Title: Delivery Pod Lead, Americas
Description: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. For enterprise customers, the data foundation runs either on our managed ClickHouse stack or warehouse-native inside the customer's own Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery. The hard problem Every enterprise customer is different, but our AI must reason the same way wherever the data lives. Your team turns messy, unique customer data into a consistent data foundation and ML, fast, and you decide how each delivery gets done. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. What You'll Do Lead and grow a small team of data and ML engineers who will be delivering the data foundation. Review solution designs and proof-of-concept scopes before they reach customers, and decide what can be delivered and how. Own each delivery after signature: staff it with the right engineers, and own its plan, timeline and quality. Stay hands-on in architecture, data discovery, canonical modeling, semantic layers, ETL and ELT orchestration across customer and Hilbert environments, secure cloud integration, and reviews of feature and model work. Help build our Data Discovery Agent, which will analyze customer data, suggest mappings and scaffold first pipelines, and bring it into your team's work as it matures. Be the main technical contact for our customers' engineering teams. Work with product engineering to turn repeated delivery work into product, and bring new industries and stacks to them early. Help our sales engineers learn the delivery side and engineering capabilities. Who You Are The player-coach: you lead engineers and still design, write and review the hard parts yourself. The translator: you earn a customer data architect's trust quickly and turn the logic of their systems into something our reasoning engine understands. The pilot: you're excited to help build AI agents that take on the heavy lifting of discovery and pipeline scaffolding. The systems thinker: you see delivery as a system, not a series of projects. You design the processes, standards, reusable patterns and automation that let a small team handle very different environments without slowing down or cutting corners. Extensive field experience in data engineering, data architecture or ML engineering, ideally from engineering consultancy or B2B delivery of data and ML projects, including leading engineers on customer projects. Hands-on delivery on Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and comfort with modern stacks such as Dagster, Airbyte, ClickHouse and Cube. Working knowledge of cloud security and system integration on AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience working in a distributed team across time zones. Fluent Spanish, for working with customers across the region. Nice to have Growth-focused data projects experience Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media Regulated industry consultancy experience Able to travel to the US when necessary Reporting and location You report to our Senior Leader for Forward Deployed Engineering. The role is based in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, or Peru with occasional visits to our largest customers in the North and South America.
